description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases designed to verify the behavior of the 'git apply' command, particularly in scenarios involving applying patches, renames, and overlapping changes. It uses test-lib.sh for testing utilities and manipulates files with sed and git commands to simulate various patch application scenarios.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: A function that applies a sed expression to a file to modify its contents, then replaces the original file with the modified version.
